notes: v1.1.107: Smart relogin - a logged-out browser account first uses Facebook's own saved login (Continue on the saved profile, straight to 2FA), then its cookie, and only then a fresh UID/password login; Save login info is turned on automatically; the live session cookie is saved on every logged-in page. Works in any Facebook language (login screens read by shape, logged-out pages forced to English); the language switch to English is fixed on m and web (e-mail code dialog read from Hotmail, code typed only into the dialog), and on phones (Facebook app language reset) and emulators (FB Lite). Request-based login: the reCAPTCHA wall is now recognised and solved by token on the hidden-browser path (faster); a browser-less reCAPTCHA token path is built but not yet confirmed live (it needs a CapSolver key, and Facebook currently shows Arkose almost everywhere), and it falls back to the proven hidden-browser path. Includes 1.1.106 (CAPTCHA step no longer reloaded away; Warm Up un-ticks accounts it can't log in / unlock / that are suspended).
